explanation: Harris died in 2002, after filming Chamber of Secrets, and Michael Gambon took over the role from Prisoner of Azkaban (2004).

claims.text: Richard Harris played Dumbledore in Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone (2001) and Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets (2002).
Michael Gambon took over Dumbledore from the third film, and Peter O'Toole and Patrick Stewart never played him in the films.
Richard Harris died in 2002, after filming Chamber of Secrets.
Michael Gambon first played Dumbledore in Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban (2004).
